sentences.text: Mithun Nandi @ Dey vs Unknown on 6 August, 2025

Ct. No.25 Sl. No. 34 Mujahid  CRA (SB) 84 of 2025  With  CRAN 1 of 2025  In Re: An application being CRAN 1 of 2025 under Section 389(1)
 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 corresponding to Section 480(1) of the BNSS, 2023.
 And  In the matter of : Mithun Nandi @ Dey  ......Appellant.
 Mr. P.K. Chatterjee,
 Ms. Maitrayee Chatterjee,
 Mr. Ashish Deb  ......for the Appellant  Mr. Rudradipta Nandy,
 Mr. Kunal Ganguly  ........for the State  In Re: CRAN 1 of 2025

1 . 
Present application has been moved for suspension of sentence.
Learned counsel for the appellant states that appellant has been convicted for the offence under Sections 448/376/511 of IPC.
Learned counsel submits that appellant remains on bail during the trial and never misused the liberty.

Learned counsel further submits that there are infirmities in the case of the prosecution in the nature of material contradiction in the testimony.
2. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the suspension of sentence on the ground that the victim and eye- witness had duly supported the case of the prosecution.
Learned counsel submits that appellant may not be admitted to bail.
3. The Court has considered the submissions normally in the case of suspension of sentence.

The court has to take a liberal view except in the cases where the offence alleged are heinous in nature or Mithun Nandi @ Dey vs Unknown on 6 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/46335077/
1
there is a possibility of appellant fleeing away from the cause of suspension.
Appellant was on bail during the course of trial, there is nothing on record to suggest that he misused the liberty the appeal may take a long time.

4. In the facts and circumstances, the sentence is suspended, the appellant is admitted to bail on furnishing a personal bond of Rs.10,000/- with two sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned trial court, subject to the condition that he shall attend the trial regularly and shall not contact the victim or the members of the family in any manner.
6. Department is directed to communicate this order to the Superintendent Kandi Sub-Divisional Correctional Home.
7. All parties shall act in terms of server copy of the order downloaded from the official website of this Court.

(Dinesh Kumar Sharma, J.)
